scenario: a5fdb6a7's new condition cannot execute, and the commit's central factual claim -- 'Both gates in front of the blit admit R5G6B5 ... So the blit is taken and the expansion is wrong' -- is false on this tree. There is a third gate in front of both. render_surface_to_texture_slow() is reached only from pgraph_gl_render_surface_to_texture(), whose single call site gl/texture.c:927 is guarded by surf_to_tex from pgraph_gl_check_surface_to_texture_compatibility() at gl/texture.c:801. That function returns false at gl/surface.c:1543 for every texture format where pgraph_texture_format_is_converted() is true, and texture.c:143 makes that predicate fall through to pgraph_texture_format_expands_by_replication() -- true for every 5- and 6-bit packed texture format. So an R5G6B5 surface-to-texture never reaches the Android blit, the condition's left operand can only be false where the second operand is already false, and the texture comes from VRAM through pgraph_convert_texture_data instead.
evidence: Derived from the switch bodies rather than asserted. android_surface_to_texture_rgba8_compatible() accepts, for LE_R5G6B5: LU_IMAGE_R5G6B5, SZ_R5G6B5; for LE_X1R5G5B5_Z1R5G5B5: LU_IMAGE_X1R5G5B5, SZ_X1R5G5B5, LU_IMAGE_A1R5G5B5, SZ_A1R5G5B5. Accepted-but-not-converted: NONE for both. In check_surface_to_texture_compatibility() the is_converted refusal is line 1543 and the first `return true` is line 1587, so the refusal precedes every true-returning path including the #ifdef __ANDROID__ early return at :1585. The two refusals are c234c1cc and f0095555, both 2026-09-12, from #59's replication work, and docs/investigations/packed-texel-expansion.md:359 in this same tree already records that check_surface_to_texture_compatiblity() 'now rejects every converted format outright'. pgraph_gl_render_surface_to_texture() has exactly one call site in the tree and no function-pointer indirection reaches it.
note: MEDIUM, not HIGH: no incorrect behaviour is introduced, nothing crashes, the desktop is untouched, the change is at worst inert. What is wrong is a factual claim in a permanent record other work is planned against -- the commit states a throughput trade ('gives up the GPU blit ... takes a CPU conversion') that does not exist, and hands #62's device half a confirmation that cannot be made: a device lane will get a byte-identical result and have to guess whether that confirms the fix or refutes the ratio/replicate model. The X1R5G5B5 sibling the lane flagged at PR body :99-104 and asked to have rated CANNOT OCCUR EITHER, by the same gate -- all four of its accepted texture formats are replication-expanding. The desktop '235 of 236 byte-identical' result is consistent with inertness and is not evidence against it; an #ifdef __ANDROID__ block cannot move a desktop pixel either way. Remediation is prose in the PR body, NOTES.md and a comment on #62, plus a decision on four lines of C: keep them with the comment rewritten to say they are a belt-and-braces guard that becomes live only if the is_converted refusal is relaxed (a live direction -- packed-texel-expansion.md calls that guard its 'least certain point'), or revert and leave the exclusion to whoever relaxes the gate. The measured arithmetic (4/32, 10/64, 23,200/65,536, and the truncating-vs-rounding reconciliation of the 09-13 30,720 figure) is correct and should be kept, moved to where it describes the VRAM round-trip that actually runs. No re-measurement and no device needed.
